title: Single highest-column cancellation for principal-open subset Cech cochains
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], $r\in\mathbf N$, $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$, $V=\bigcup_iD(f_i)$ and $D_S=D(\prod_{j\in S}f_j)$. Let $J$ be an unbounded cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let $T$ be a complex of $A$-modules, with degreewise linear isomorphisms $\tau_n:T^n\cong\prod_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}(r)}\Gamma(D_S,J^{n+1-|S|})$. Under $\tau$, assume its differential at $S$ is $(-1)^{|S|-1}d_J$ plus the signed sum over $j\in S$ of restriction from $D_{S\setminus\{j\}}$, with sign $(-1)^{|\{i\in S:i<j\}|}$; empty deletions contribute zero. Inclusions $D_S\subseteq D_{S\setminus\{j\}}$ and equalities $n+1-|S\setminus\{j\}|=n+2-|S|$ specify the transports in this formula. If $n\in\mathbf Z$, $k\ge1$, the single coefficient sheaf $J^{n-k}$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and $t\in T^n$ has zero coordinates at every $S$ with $|S|>k+1$, and $d_Tt$ has zero coordinates at every $S$ with $|S|>1$, then there exists $u\in T^{n-1}$ such that $t-d_Tu$ has zero coordinates at every $S$ with $|S|>k$.

source.place: Tag 08C1, lemma-alternating-cech-complex-complex, first paragraph; finite augmented row calculation

proof.text: At cardinality k+2, use the support of t to remove the vertical differential in d(t); the hypothesis that d(t) vanishes there proves the horizontal cocycle equation. Apply subset row exactness to obtain b supported at cardinality k.

Define u by applying the inverse of the degree n-1 coordinate isomorphism to b. The inverse identity gives its coordinates exactly b. At any subset of size greater than k the vertical differential is zero. At size k+1 the horizontal differential is the row primitive equation; above k+1 every deleted subset has size different from k, so every summand is zero and t is zero as well. The coordinate isomorphism preserves subtraction. Integer indices are normalized by introducing m with n=m+1 before the dependent calculation.

theorem principalOpenCech_column_step
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let D : Finset (Fin r) → (Spec (.of A)).Opens :=
      fun S ↦ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (∏ j ∈ S, f j)
    ∀ (T : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (τ : ∀ n : ℤ, T.X n ≅ ModuleCat.of A
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj (op (D S.val))))
      (hle : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), D S ≤ D (S.erase j))
      (he : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), j ∈ S → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n + 1 - ((S.erase j).card : ℤ) = n + 1 + 1 - (S.card : ℤ)),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (s : T.X n) (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}),
        (τ (n + 1)).hom (T.d n (n + 1) s) S =
          (-1 : A) ^ (S.val.card - 1) •
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map
              (J.d (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)) (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).hom.app
                (op (D S.val)) ((τ n).hom s S) +
          ∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val))) ((τ n).hom s ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0) →
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → Injective (J.X (n - (k : ℤ))) → ∀ t : T.X n,
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
          k + 1 < S.val.card → (τ n).hom t S = 0) →
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
          1 < S.val.card → (τ (n + 1)).hom (T.d n (n + 1) t) S = 0) →
        ∃ u : T.X (n - 1), ∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
          k < S.val.card → (τ n).hom (t - T.d (n - 1) n u) S = 0
